input.quote: Risk of loss for all Base Components shall at all times remain with IBM. Risk of loss for all Customer Components shall at all times remain with Customer.
input.rationale: The agreement contains no insurance clause: the section outline has no insurance heading, and searches for "insur" return no hits anywhere in the document (Section 14.12 Risk of Loss and Section 5.3 Security are the nearest neighbours and address allocation of risk and security features only, not coverage). IBM is a hosting provider operating the e-business Hosting Environment and holding Customer Components, so the absence of any insurance obligation sits in walk-away territory under the rule (no insurance for a vendor that processes our data). We therefore insert a short insurance section after Section 14.12 at the preferred position (CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M, workers' compensation as required by law, certificates on request), with the E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M fallback flagged in the comment.

proposal.summary: Insert a new Section 14.12A requiring IBM to maintain CGL, E&O and cyber liability insurance and to provide certificates on request.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added a short insurance section, as the agreement currently has none even though IBM hosts our environment and processes our data. Our playbook position is CGL of USD 1M/2M, professional liability of USD 2M and cyber liability of USD 5M with certificates on request; we can discuss E&O of USD 1M and cyber of USD 2M as a fallback.

ops.text: IBM shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the term of this Agreement and for one (1) year thereafter: (a) commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate; (b) professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000; (c) where IBM hosts, stores or otherwise processes Customer Components or other Customer data, cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000; and (d) workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable law. IBM shall provide certificates of insurance evidencing such coverage upon Customer's request.
